deadline.value: Fall materials should reach the department by February 1 for fullest consideration; the Graduate School's international fall deadline is May 1.
deadline.quote: For fullest consideration, fall semester admission application materials should be received by Feb. 1 of that year

gre_general.value: The department does not require GRE General scores.
gre_general.quote: No, GRE scores are not required.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the Chemistry GRE Subject test or any GRE exams.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require GRE exams.

supervisor.value: Applications are reviewed by a department admissions committee, and applicants do not need to contact a potential advisor first.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to contact potential research advisor(s)

funding.value: Most graduate students in the department receive some form of financial support; PhD students are eligible for support for five academic years after admission.
funding.quote: Most graduate students in the department receive some form of financial support

entry_route.value: Applicants need a baccalaureate or master's degree in chemistry or biochemistry; related disciplines may also be considered.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a baccalaureate or master's degree in chemistry or biochemistry

notes: Assistantships are awarded competitively; the financial-support page says teaching assistantships include a tuition waiver.
